text: The pipeline works and the dashboard is live -- but none of that survives you leaving unless it's written down for someone who wasn't in any of the last eighteen meetings.
Three documents, three readers: a data dictionary for Billing, a prose lineage for the next engineer, and an on-call runbook for whoever gets paged.
Monthly Billing Credit is defined plainly -- and what it excludes matters just as much, including the exact duplicate-event rule that came out of August's fix.
The runbook runs cheapest check first: Kinesis iterator age, Lambda errors, Glue, Step Functions. And it says plainly which of those would not have caught August's bug.
This platform can now be maintained by someone other than the person who built it. Last video: the honest wrap-up on what changed, and what's still manual.
